name: Yuuwaku Patissier ~Kuchibiru no Gohoubi~
original_name: 誘惑パティシエ～唇のご褒美～
source:
You've taken over your grandfather's cake shop after his passing.
Since you're still new to pastry-making,
three charming patissiers have agreed to train you!

Will you be able to keep the shop open?
And will the sweet scents make you fall in love?!

It's a sweet, yet high tension story of romance!

[translated from [url=https://www.renaigame.xyz/apps/temptationpastry/index.html]official website[/url]]
translation:
你祖父去世后，你接管了他的蛋糕店。
由于你对糕点制作还是新手，
三位迷人的糕点师同意训练你！

你能继续开店吗？
甜蜜的香味会让你坠入爱河吗？！

这是一个甜蜜而又紧张的浪漫故事！

[翻译自[url=https://www.renaigame.xyz/apps/temptationpastry/index.html]官网[/url]]
